description_en: Retrieves the metadata of the target data source
description_zh: 调用GetDataSourceMeta获取目标数据源的Meta信息
name: GetDataSourceMeta

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the target data source
parameters.name: datasource_name

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The environment to which the target data source belongs. Valid values:
0: development environment
1: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所属的环境。取值如下：
0：开发环境。
1：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

Data.description_en: The result of retrieving the metadata of the target data source
Data.description_zh: 获取目标数据源Meta信息的返回的结果

Message.description_en: The description of the failure cause when the metadata of the target data source fails to be retrieved. If the metadata is successfully retrieved, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh: 获取目标数据源Meta信息失败后的原因描述。如果获取目标数据源的Meta信息成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Meta.description_en:
The returned metadata of the target data source. The returned information is in JSON format.

`{"dbTables":[{"dbName":"testdb","schema":[{"tableInfos":[{"dbName":"testdb","enable":true,"table":"table1","tableName":"table1"}]},{"tableInfos":[{"dbName":"testdb","enable":true,"table":"table2","tableName":"table2"}]}]}]}`

The parameters are described as follows:
dbName: the name of the database where the data source resides.
schema: the schema to which the database belongs.
enable: specifies whether the database is available. Valid values: true (the database is available) and false (the database is unavailable).
tableName: the name of the table in the database.
tableInfos: the information about the tables in the database
Meta.description_zh:
返回的目标数据源的Meta信息。返回的信息为JSON格式。

`{"dbTables":[{"dbName":"testdb","schema":[{"tableInfos":[{"dbName":"testdb","enable":true,"table":"table1","tableName":"table1"}]},{"tableInfos":[{"dbName":"testdb","enable":true,"table":"table2","tableName":"table2"}]}]}]}`

参数描述如下：
dbName：数据源所在的数据库名称。
schema：数据库所属的模式。
enable：数据库是否可用，包含true（表示数据库可用），false（表示数据库不可用）取值。
tableName：数据库包含的表名称。
tableInfos：数据库中表的信息

Status.description_en:
The status of the metadata retrieval result for the target data source. Valid values:
success: The metadata of the target data source is successfully retrieved.
fail: The metadata of the target data source fails to be retrieved. You can check the Message parameter to locate the cause of the failure
Status.description_zh:
获取目标数据源Meta信息的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示获取目标数据源的Meta信息成功。
fail：表示获取目标数据源的Meta信息失败。您可以查看Message参数定位失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues when an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。用于出现错误后定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
